dedupe_keys.name: building model open source energy model of every french dwelling energy alternatives

description: Building Model is an open-source building energy simulation tool meant not to model one building perfectly but to simulate the energy consumption of a very large number of buildings, potentially all of France, for every energy carrier (biomass, town gas, bottled gas, electricity, heating oil) with a representation of each building. Inputs are inferred from open data available nationwide, chiefly the IGN BD TOPO, the INSEE census and energy performance certificates, and the heating model is a first-order model close to the French 3CL DPE method, accounting for dwelling performance, solar gains and shading. The blog post describes simulating all residential consumption of all dwellings in all IRIS areas of France and calibrating to observed local consumption. Coverage: France. Access: code on GitLab (active in September 2026). Licence: MIT. Caveats: cooling is not yet modelled in detail, and inferred inputs carry the known biases of DPE data. Simulation uses: national and local heat demand scenarios, retrofit programmes and electrification of heating. Related records: the Scottish EPC register, the Irish BER dataset and ResStock.
